class A: pass
a=A()
setattr(a,'x',7)
print(getattr(a,'x'),hasattr(a,'x'),getattr(a,'missing',9))
delattr(a,'x')
print(hasattr(a,'x'))

class A:
 def __init__(self): self.__x=1
a=A()
setattr(a,'__x',2)
print(getattr(a,'__x'),getattr(a,'_A__x'))

class A:
 def __iadd__(self,other): return NotImplemented
 def __add__(self,other): return other+4
a=A()
a+=3
print(a)

class A:
 def __rsub__(self,other): return other+2
 def __neg__(self): return 9
print(3-A(),-A())

class A:
 def __pow__(self,other,mod=None): return other if mod is None else mod
 def __rpow__(self,other,mod=None): return other+1
 def __divmod__(self,other): return (other,3)
a=A()
b=divmod(a,7)
print(pow(a,4),pow(a,4,9),pow(2,a),b[0],b[1])
